scripts.app:rebuild: docker compose down -v && docker compose up --build
scripts.db:generate: docker compose run --rm api npm run db:generate
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose run --rm api npm run db:migrate
scripts.db:push: docker compose run --rm api npm run db:push
scripts.db:check: docker compose run --rm api npm run db:check
scripts.db:seed: docker compose run --rm api npm run db:seed
scripts.db:studio: docker compose run --rm -p 4983:4983 api npm run db:studio
